claim: V07 §5.1 (l. 3248–3249) calls the shade map 'a `setLayer` toggle, never on by default'. The shade map is V09 §5.4's thematic view, chosen by the per-viewer view key `thematic` at `shade` (§2.9, l. 3500; §4.5, l. 6239), which sends no event; `setLayer` is a logged edit of a model layer's `LayerSpec` (§8.4, l. 13677, which now adds 'no drawing group by `setLayer`', the thematic overrides being §2.1's drawing groups). V05 (l. 228) calls it volume 9's. The village supplies only VS1's `daylight.terrain`, so nothing built changes.
required_change: V07 §5.1: replace 'a `setLayer` toggle, never on by default' with 'shown by the per-viewer view key `thematic` at `shade` (§2.9; V09 §5.4), `none` by default'.
